faqs.question: What is the home loan interest rate?
faqs.answer: Our home loan interest rates start at 8.5% per annum with tenures up to 30 years and zero processing fee on select schemes.

faqs.question: How does a personal loan work?
faqs.answer: A personal loan provides a lump sum that you repay with interest in fixed monthly installments (EMIs) over a chosen tenure of 1 to 5 years without collateral.

faqs.question: What are the Fixed Deposit interest rates?
faqs.answer: We offer attractive FD rates: 6.0% p.a. for 1 year, 6.5% p.a. for 3 years, and 7.0% p.a. for 5 years. Senior citizens receive an additional 0.5%.

faqs.question: How do I open an account?
faqs.answer: You can open an account in 5 minutes using Video KYC with your Aadhaar and PAN card, or visit your nearest branch.

faqs.question: How can I block my card?
faqs.answer: To block a lost or stolen card, call our 24x7 toll-free helpline at 1800-123-4567 or request assistance via FinChat.
